test_coverage_gaps.description: No fixture for malformed or legacy productMap keys such as store::campaignId still present after a failed migration.
test_coverage_gaps.why_it_matters: The detector expects campaign keys shaped as store::platform::campaignId; legacy keys can be retained by migration when platform cannot be inferred, so a regression could count an orphaned legacy mapping as a cohort member.
test_coverage_gaps.suggested_fixture: Map p1 to uzoshop::Meta::c1 plus uzoshop::c2 with daily rows only for c1; assert the legacy key does not create a false multi-mapped verdict, or document the intended composition_changed/insufficient behavior.

test_coverage_gaps.description: No fixture for duplicate product IDs inside a single campaign's productMap array.
test_coverage_gaps.why_it_matters: readProductMap validates string arrays but does not dedupe historical/cloud data; duplicates should not make one campaign look like a two-member cohort.
test_coverage_gaps.suggested_fixture: Use {"uzoshop::Meta::c1":["p1","p1"]} with normal campaign/product rows and assert detectProductCannibalization returns [] because there is only one distinct campaign.

test_coverage_gaps.description: Consumer contract for revenueGrowthPct=null is covered at detector level, but not at the CohortComparisonPanel rendering/sort boundary.
test_coverage_gaps.why_it_matters: The null sentinel fix depends on UI and JSON consumers treating null consistently; a future formatter/sort regression could reintroduce operator-visible drift without breaking detector tests.
test_coverage_gaps.suggested_fixture: Render CohortComparisonPanel with one verdict whose metrics.revenueGrowthPct is null and assert the displayed percent is n/a/לא מוגדר-equivalent and sorting remains stable.
